Name.comment: Bonus title string. This is only necessary if this bonus changes Legitimacy or it is a mission result or tech bonus discovery that grants a courtier

zIcon.comment: Bonus icon. This is only shown in tech tooltips

AchievementIfHeir.comment: Player gets this Achievement if target subject is Heir

AchievementIfOtherLeader.comment: Player gets this Achievement if target subject is Leader of other nation

Memory.comment: Memory received by the Player Subject

Forget.comment: Memory forgotten by the Player Subject

MemoryAllPlayers.comment: Memory received by all rival Players

MemoryAllFamilies.comment: Memory received by all your noble Families

MemoryLeader.comment: Memory received by the leader of the Player Subject

AddLeaderRelationship.comment: Add a Relationship towards the Leader

RemoveLeaderRelationship.comment: Remove a Relationship towards the Leader

DiplomacyPlayerFrom.comment: Diplomacy state (from diplomacy.xml) to which the Player Subject is set, initiated by Us

DiplomacyPlayerTo.comment: Diplomacy state (from diplomacy.xml) to which the Player Subject is set, initiated by the Other Player

DiplomacyAllPlayers.comment: Sets the Player subject to this diplomacy state with all other players, initiated by this player subject

DiplomacyTribe.comment: Diplomacy state (from diplomacy.xml) to which the Barbarian Subject is set

MakeCourtier.comment: Makes the character Subject into this type of courtier which is added to the Player's court

StartLaw.comment: Law enacted. You must pay the normal Civics cost

FreeLaw.comment: Law enacted for free (i.e. no Civics cost)

FreeTheology.comment: Theology added to your state Religion (if any)

GoalAdd.comment: A Quest given to the Player (similar to Ambitions)

GoalForce.comment: A Quest given to the Player (similar to Ambitions), but does not check if the Quest is close to complete

Ambition.comment: Adds this Ambition to the Player

AmbitionFamily.comment: Adds this Ambition to the Player (for this Family)

AmbitionReligion.comment: Adds this Ambition to the Player (for this Religion)

Council.comment: Makes the Character this Council member

SetArchetype.comment: Gives the Character this Archetype Trait (and will remove the old one)

SetName.comment: Changes the Character's name to this name type (will remove custom name if present)

SetNickname.comment: Changes the Character's nickname to this name type (will override any other nickname)

SetTitle.comment: Changes the Character's title to this type (will override any other title)

SetCognomen.comment: Changes the Character's Cognomen (cannot be applied to the Leader)

SetTerrain.comment: Sets the Tile's Terrain (will not work on tiles with a resource, vegetation, or improvement)

AddResource.comment: Adds Improvement to a random valid Tile for the City Subject

SetEventTimer.comment: Sets an event timer on tile

AddImprovement.comment: Adds Improvement to a random valid Tile for the City Subject

AddImprovementClass.comment: Adds a random Improvement Class to a random valid Tile for the City Subject

BirthCharacter.comment: When using iBirthWithSubject, the child will be this predefined character

OccurrenceStartPlayer.comment: Starts this Occurrence for the target Player

OccurrenceEndPlayer.comment: Ends this Occurrence for the target Player

OccurrenceForce.comment: Starts this global Occurrence without checking whether it is valid to start

OccurrenceForcePlayer.comment: Starts this Occurrence for the target Player without checking whether it is valid to start

SetCooldown.comment: Sets this cooldown for the Unit subject

ForceFamilySupremacy.comment: Sets the supremacy EffectPlayer to that of the given Family. Will only affect nations with bCoalition.

iSpreadUnits.comment: List of Religion units that will appear near the City Subject

iRevealRange.comment: Reveals this range distance from the Tile

iCitizens.comment: Number of citizens added to the City Subject

iBorderGrowth.comment: Adds this many Tiles to the City's territory

iCultureLevels.comment: Number of Culture levels (regardless of cost) gained by the City Subject

iHappinessLevels.comment: Number of Happiness levels gained by the City Subject

iEmergencyUnits.comment: Number of the weakest emergency units (non-promotable military) to be granted

iRebelUnits.comment: Number of rebel Units spawned by the City Subject. Unit types are randomly picked among units buildable by the city

iDestroyImprovements.comment: Number of random Improvements destroyed at the City Subject

iHPCity.comment: Changes the HP of the City

iHPCityPercent.comment: Changes the HP of the City by this percent

iHPUnit.comment: Changes the HP of the Unit

iHPUnitAdjacent.comment: Changes the HP of Unit subject, and any units adjacent to the Unit subject, if they belong to the same team

iXPUnit.comment: Changes the XP of the Unit

iFatigueUnit.comment: Changes the Fatigue of the Unit

iNextCritical.comment: The unit subject's next attack gets this bonus to critical chance

iXPCharacter.comment: Changes the XP of the Character

iLegitimacy.comment: Amount of Legitimacy gained or lost by the Human

iTradeTurns.comment: Turns of Yields given in Trade (if 0 defaults to TRADE_TURNS)

iTributeTurns.comment: Turns of Yields given in Tribute (if 0 defaults to TRIBUTE_TURNS)

iBuildTurns.comment: Modifies the build turns of the Improvement on this Tile Subject

iImprovementNameSubject.comment: If this bonus adds an improvement, try to name the improvement using DynamicName, after this subject

iContactSubject.comment: Make contact with the previous player or tribe subject at this index

iAllianceSubject.comment: Player allies with the previous Subject at this index

iMarrySubject.comment: Character will marry the previous Subject at this index

iMarryAwaySubject.comment: Character will marry the previous Subject at this index (allows moving to another player)

iPolyMarrySubject.comment: Character will marry the previous Subject at this index (allows polygamy)

iDivorcedBySubject.comment: Character will divorce the previous Subject at this index

iBirthWithSubject.comment: Character will give birth with the previous Subject at this index

iAdoptedBySubject.comment: Character will be adopted by the previous Subject at this index

iConvertedBySubject.comment: Character will convert to the Religion of the previous Subject at this index

iGovernorOfSubject.comment: Character will be Governor of the previous Subject City at this index

iGeneralOfSubject.comment: Character will be General of the previous Subject Unit at this index

iExplorerOfSubject.comment: Character will be Explorer of the previous Subject Unit at this index

iJoinSubject.comment: Character will join the Player at the previous Subject at this index

iJoinReverse.comment: Character at the previous Subject at this index will join the Player

iSeizeThroneSubject.comment: Become the new leader of the previous Subject at this index

iRegentOfSubject.comment: Become the regent of the previous Player Subject at this index

iSpreadToSubject.comment: Religion will spread to the previous Subject City at this index

iRemoveFromSubject.comment: Religion will be removed from the previous Subject City at this index

iConvertReligionSubject.comment: The previous Subject Character at this index will convert to this Religion

iHeadReligionSubject.comment: The previous Subject Character at this index will become Head of this Religion

iHeadFamilySubject.comment: The previous Subject Character at this index will become Head of this Family

iAcquireTechSubject.comment: The previous Subject at this index acquires the Tech

iAddTechToDiscardSubject.comment: The previous Subject at this index puts the Tech in their discard pile

iTradeResourceToSubject.comment: Trades the Resources to previous Subject at this index

iTradeResourceFromSubject.comment: Trades the Resources from previous Subject at this index

iAddTraitSubject.comment: Adds Trait to the previous Subject at this index

iRemoveTraitSubject.comment: Removes the Trait from the previous Subject at this index

iAgentCitySubject.comment: Character will become the Agent in the previous Subject City at this index

iMoveNetworkCitySubject.comment: Agent Network will move to the Subject City from the City of the previous Subject Agent Character at this index

iTradeCitySubject.comment: Trade the City to the previous Subject at this index

iAttackCitySubject.comment: City becomes the attack target of the Subject at this index

iConvertUnitSubject.comment: Converts the Unit to the previous Subject at this index

iMissionSubject.comment: The Mission will target the previous Subject at this index

iMissionReverse.comment: The Mission character will be the previous Subject at this index

iAmbitionFamilySubject.comment: Subject index of the Family for this Ambition

iAmbitionReligionSubject.comment: Subject index of the Religion for this Ambition

iOccurrenceTargetSubject.comment: Subject index of the target Tile or Player for this Occurrence

bMissionFree.comment: The Mission will not have Yield costs

bMercenaryUnit.comment: The Units created will not be processed through a City (so, no Family, for example)

bRevealTerritory.comment: Will reveal all the territory of this Player

bHolyCityAgents.comment: Adds an Agent in all Holy Cities

bCancelTrade.comment: Will cancel trade with this Player

bCancelTribute.comment: Will cancel tribute to this Player

bPeaceOffer.comment: Triggers a Peace Offer from this Player

bTruceOffer.comment: Triggers a Truce Offer from this Player

bTeamAlliance.comment: Will make an Alliance with this Player

bTeamAllianceEnd.comment: Will end an Alliance with this Player

bTribeAlliance.comment: Will make an Alliance with this Barbarian

bTribeAllianceEnd.comment: Will end an Alliance with this Barbarian

bTribeInvade.comment: Tribe will send a number of Units to raid the Player

bAdoptReligion.comment: Adopt this Religion the Player's State Religion (with paying the cost)

bStateReligion.comment: Set this Religion the Player's State Religion (without paying the cost)

bFoundReligion.comment: The Player will found a random Religion

bFoundReligionCity.comment: The Player will found a random Religion in this City

bStartLaw.comment: Starts the Law and pays the Civics cost

bFreeLaw.comment: Starts the Law without paying the cost

bFreeTheology.comment: Establishes the Theology without paying the cost

bChangeTheology.comment: Changes to this Theology (requires an active one at this Tier)

bAddAmbition.comment: Adds Ambition Subject for the Player

bAddAmbitionIgnoreEligible.comment: Adds Ambition Subject for the Player, valid regardless of ambition tier and threshold

bRandomTech.comment: The Player will receive a random free Tech

bRandomCourtier.comment: The Player will receive a random Courtier

bDistantRaid.comment: The City will be the target of a Raid from a Distant Land

bAddAgentNetwork.comment: Player's Agent Network added to the City

bLoseAgentNetwork.comment: Player's Agent Network removed in the City

bExposeAgentNetwork.comment: Removes a foreign Agent Network in the City (chosen randomly if there are multiples)

bConvertStateReligion.comment: Set this Character's Religion to the Player's State Religion

bRemoveReligion.comment: Remove this Character's Religion (they will follow no religion)

bNoCourtier.comment: Character will no longer be a Courtier

bLeaveCouncil.comment: Character will no longer be on the Council

bReleaseGeneral.comment: If set to 1 (true), the character Subject will be released from being a general

bReleaseExplorer.comment: If set to 1 (true), the character Subject will be released from being an explorer

bReleaseGovernor.comment: If set to 1 (true), the character Subject will be released from being a governor

bReleaseAgent.comment: If set to 1 (true), the character Subject will be released from being an agent

bLeaveNation.comment: If set to 1 (true), the character Subject will leave their current nation and will remain in the game but not assigned to any nation

bChangeSuccession.comment: If set to 1 (true), the game will automatically attempt to set the Player’s inheritance laws so that the character Subject will become your direct heir. Any law changes made cost no Civics

bAbdicate.comment: If set to 1 (true), the character Subject abdicates the throne

bChosenHeir.comment: Make this Character the Chosen Heir

bAddCharacter.comment: If set to 1 (true), the character is added to the game (only for a CharacterType from character.xml).

bKillCharacter.comment: If set to 1 (true), the character Subject dies immediately

bKillCharacterSafe.comment: If set to 1 (true), the character Subject dies immediately, even if the character is marked safe. For use in scenarios

bHaveBastard.comment: Character will have a bastard child

bKillUnit.comment: If set to 1 (true), the Unit Subject dies immediately

bClearResource.comment: Removes Resource from the Tile. Only works if no Improvement is present

bPillageImprovement.comment: Pillages the Improvement on the Tile

bRepairImprovement.comment: Repairs the Improvement on the Tile

bTribeRaid.comment: Starts a raid from the Barbarian settlement on the Tile

bRazeCityNoCitySite.comment: Razes the City Subject, and disables its city site

bAbandonCity.comment: The city subject descends into Anarchy

bCapitalCity.comment: The city subject becomes the capital of its current owner

bNoLogEntry.comment: Disables player log entries for this bonus

bOverrideDescription.comment: Use the Name of this bonus to display it instead of dynamic effect-based text

bIgnoreDelayTurns.comment: Used when starting Occurrences to ignore delay turns

bOccurrenceStart.comment: Used to start an Occurrence subject

bOccurrenceSetPending.comment: Used when starting an Occurrence with OccurrenceStart, iOccurrenceSubject, or alone on an Occurrence subject to set as pending and not currently active

bOccurrenceStartPending.comment: Used to start a pending Occurrence subject

bSetFamilySupremacy.comment: Sets the supremacy EffectPlayer to that of this Family. Will only affect nations with bCoalition.

bCouncilCheck.comment: if true, makes sure the council member is not on cooldown before setting.

aiCityYields.comment: List of Yields (Money, Science, etc.) gained in the City Subject

aiGlobalYields.comment: List of Yields (Money, Science, etc.) gained by the Player. Unlike the other Global Yield values, this is unmodified by inflation.

aiGlobalYieldsBase.comment: List of Yields (Money, Science, etc.) gained by the Player. This is distinct from aicityYields in that it is added directly to the national stockpile, not to any particular City.

aiGlobalYieldsPer.comment: List of Yields per City gained by the Player. For example, if this is 20 Money, and the Player has 3 cities, the Player will gain 60 Money.

aiOtherYieldsBase.comment: List of Yields (Money, Science, etc.) gained by the Player

aiOtherYieldsPer.comment: List of Yields per City gained by the Other Player. For example, if this is 20 Money, and the Other Player has 3 cities, the Player will gain 60 Money

aiYieldLevels.comment: List of Yield level changes for a City

aiYieldsSend.comment: Send this Yield (lump sum) to the other Player (and deduct it from this Player's stockpile). Unlike the other Global Yield values, this is unmodified by inflation.

aiYieldsSendBase.comment: Send this Yield (lump sum) to the other Player (and deduct it from this Player's stockpile).

aiYieldsSendPerUs.comment: Send this Yield (per this Player's Cities) to the other Player (and deduct it from this Player's stockpile).

aiYieldsSendPerThem.comment: Send this Yield (per other Player's Cities) to the other Player (and deduct it from this Player's stockpile).

aiYieldsTradeBase.comment: List of Yields (lump sum) gained in trade. If this value is positive, this Player receives the Yields; if it’s negative, the other Player receives the Yields

aiYieldsTradePerUs.comment: List of Yields (per this Player's Cities) gained in trade. If this value is positive, this Player receives the Yields; if it’s negative, the other Player receives the Yields

aiYieldsTradePerThem.comment: List of Yields (per other Player's Cities) gained in trade. If this value is positive, this Player receives the Yields; if it’s negative, the other Player receives the Yields

aiYieldsTributeBase.comment: List of Yields (lump sum) to be given to this Subject as tribute. If this value is positive, the Player will receive tribute; if it’s negative, the Player will give tribute

aiYieldsTributePerUs.comment: List of Yields (per this Player's Cities) to be given to this Subject as tribute. If this value is positive, the Player will receive tribute; if it’s negative, the Player will give tribute

aiYieldsTributePerThem.comment: List of Yields (per other Player's Cities) to be given to this Subject as tribute. If this value is positive, the Player will receive tribute; if it’s negative, the Player will give tribute

aiUnits.comment: List of Units that will appear near the City Subject

aiVegetationTerritory.comment: List of vegetation types that will be added within the City Subject's territory

aiTribeUnits.comment: List of Tribe Units that will appear near the Tile Subject. If the Tile does not belong to any Tribe, Barbarians will spawn.

aiBonusUnits.comment: List of bonus Units (from bonusUnitClass.xml) that will appear near the Subject City. bonusUnitClass awards you the highest-indexed Unit you have researched in the indicated category

aiRebelUnits.comment: List of bonus units from bonusUnitClass.xml to spawn as rebels near the Subject City. The highest-indexed unit that the city's owner has researched appears

aeNewUnitNames.comment: Newly spawned units or bonus units will have custom names from this list

aiLawOpinion.comment: List of permanent opinion changes to laws added to the Family Subject. For example, if you could put Centralization and -5 here, the Family would gain a -5 opinion of the Centralization law

aiRatings.comment: List of changes to ratings (Charisma, Courage, etc.) applied to the character Subject

aiTraitProb.comment: Probability (out of 100) of acquiring this trait

aiTraitProbDelay.comment: Probability (out of 100) of acquiring this trait on the following Turn

aiStats.comment: List of stats to change for the player subject

aeAddProjects.comment: List of projects added to the City Subject

aeRemoveProjects.comment: List of projects removed from the City Subject

aeAddSpecialistClasses.comment: List of specialists to be added to the City Subject

aeEffectUnits.comment: List of unit effects gained by the Unit led by the character Subject

aeRandomTrait.comment: One of these will be randomly added to the character Subject

aeRandomTraitDelay.comment: One of these will be randomly added to the character Subject on the following Turn

aeRandomTraitText.comment: Text that will describe how the new random Trait was acquired

aeAddTraits.comment: List of traits gained by the character Subject

aeRemoveTraits.comment: List of traits removed from the character Subject

aeRandomLeaderRelationship.comment: One of these relationships will be randomly created with the Leader

aeRandomLeaderRelationshipDelay.comment: One of these relationships will be randomly created with the Leader on the following Turn

aeRandomLeaderRelationshipText.comment: Text that will describe how the new random Leader Relationship happened

aeTechs.comment: List of techs gained by the Player

aeCultureProject.comment: List of projects added to the City Subject, based on the City’s Culture value in zIndex

aaiCultureYield.comment: List of Yields added to the City Subject, based on the City’s Culture value in zIndex

aeBonuses.comment: List of other bonuses to be added onto this one. This is for use with the scaling bonuses found in bonus.xml. [Please avoid making infinite bonus loops.]

aeFamilyBonuses.comment: Bonuses are applied to all Cities of this Family

aeReligionBonuses.comment: Bonuses are applied to all Cities with this religion (in the player's nation)

aeImportResources.comment: Adds a resource to the player, not associated with any city

aeForceResources.comment: Resources are placed on tiles in the city. If no valid tiles exist, they are placed on normally invalid tiles

aeAllCityBonuses.comment: Bonuses are applied to all the Player's Cities

aeScriptTileBonuses.comment: Pairs where zIndex is a tag set by the map generator at generation tim, and the value is the bonus to be applied to all such tiles

aeEffectCityBonuses.comment: Bonuses applied to the City subject, once per specified EffectCity

DiplomacySubjects.comment: Subject will enter this Diplomacy state with the previous Subject at this index

AddRelationshipSubjects.comment: Give this Character a Relationship with the previous Character at this index

AddRelationshipReverse.comment: Give the previous Character at this index a Relationship with this Character

RemoveRelationshipSubjects.comment: Remove the Relationship of this Character with the previous Character at this index

RemoveRelationshipReverse.comment: Remove the Relationship of the previous Character at this index with this Character

RemoveRelationshipSubjectsOption.comment: Remove the Relationship of this Character with the previous Character at this index (does not require the Relationship to exist)

RemoveRelationshipReverseOption.comment: Remove the Relationship of the previous Character at this index with this Character (does not require the Relationship to exist)

AddCharacter.comment: List of premade Characters to add to the Player Subject

AddCourtier.comment: List of courtiers with assigned gender to be added to the Subjects's court

AddCourtierOther.comment: List of courtiers with assigned gender to be added to the Humans's court but with the Subject's nationality

AddTraitReligion.comment: Add Trait based on the Character's Religion

RemoveTraitReligion.comment: Remove Trait based on the Character's Religion

Entry.comment: General character bonuses: Bonuses applicable to any character (subject: CHARACTER_US or CHARACTER_THEM)
Set a character to an archetype (even if they already had one)
Add positive interpersonal traits
Add negative interpersonal traits
Add combat traits
Add skill traits
Modify character ability ratings
Non-leader character bonuses: Bonuses applicable to characters that are not the triggering player's leader (not LEADER_US)
Add a relationship to a character, relating them to current LEADER_US
Remove a relationship from a character, that related them to current LEADER_US
Add a character to a council position, if unlocked, or remove them from one
Set a character to courtier, effecting resource yields and allowing jobs outside archetype (the four types have no direct mechanical difference)
City bonuses: Bonuses applicable to cities (SUBJECT_CITY)
Adds agent network to a CITY_THEM
Adds friendly or rebel units to random applicable tile in city
Set terrain on specific tile in city
Adds resource to random applicable tile in city
Unit bonuses: Bonuses to apply to a unit (SUBJECT_UNIT)
Set sea unit promotions
Tile bonuses: Bonuses to apply to a tile (SUBJECT_TILE)
Religion events: Bonuses to apply to a relegion subject (SUBJECT_RELIGION)
Non-player nation bonuses: Bonuses applied to nations other than the triggering one (subject: PLAYER_THEM)
For opponent player declaring war
For player declaring unprovoked war
For opponent player declaring war (and player gains legitimacy)
Entry.Name: TEXT_BONUS_PLAYER_WAR_LEGITIMACY

Entry.comment: Tribe bonuses: Bonuses applied to tribes (SUBJECT_TRIBE)
Tribe sends hostile units toward player without formal war
For tribe declaring war
For player declaring arbitrary war on a tribe
For player declaring war on a tribe, and gaining legitimacy
Entry.Name: TEXT_BONUS_TRIBE_WAR_LEGITIMACY

Entry.comment: Triggering player bonuses: Bonuses to apply to the nation triggering the event (subject: PLAYER_US)
Add or subtract from a nation's resource stockpiles
Add an ambition
Add a free law (no civics cost)
